IDS.name: plasma_profiles
IDS.documentation: Plasma profiles (core and/or edge). This IDS is a prototype based on the merge of core_profiles, edge_profiles and the MHD IDS, for testing purposes only at this stage. It contains magnetic field maps to describe magnetic field fluctuations, while the equilibrium magnetic field is described in the equilibrium IDS

field.name: vacuum_toroidal_field
field.documentation: Characteristics of the vacuum toroidal field (used in rho_tor definition and in the normalization of current densities)

field.name: r0
field.documentation: Reference major radius where the vacuum toroidal magnetic field is given (usually a fixed position such as the middle of the vessel at the equatorial midplane)

field.name: b0
field.documentation: Vacuum toroidal field at R0 [T]; Positive sign means anti-clockwise when viewing from above. The product R0B0 must be consistent with the b_tor_vacuum_r field of the tf IDS.

field.name: midplane
field.documentation: Choice of midplane definition (use the lowest index number if more than one value is relevant)

field.name: index
field.documentation: Integer identifier (enumeration index within a list). Private identifier values must be indicated by a negative index.

field.name: global_quantities
field.documentation: Various global quantities derived from the profiles

field.name: ip
field.documentation: Total plasma current (toroidal component). Positive sign means anti-clockwise when viewed from above.

field.name: current_non_inductive
field.documentation: Total non-inductive current (toroidal component). Positive sign means anti-clockwise when viewed from above.

field.name: current_bootstrap
field.documentation: Bootstrap current (toroidal component). Positive sign means anti-clockwise when viewed from above.

field.name: v_loop
field.documentation: LCFS loop voltage (positive value drives positive ohmic current that flows anti-clockwise when viewed from above)

field.name: li_3
field.documentation: Internal inductance. The li_3 definition is used, i.e. li_3 = 2/R0/mu0^2/Ip^2 * int(Bp^2 dV).

field.name: beta_tor
field.documentation: Toroidal beta, defined as the volume-averaged total perpendicular pressure divided by (B0^2/(2*mu0)), i.e. beta_toroidal = 2 mu0 int(p dV) / V / B0^2

field.name: beta_tor_norm
field.documentation: Normalised toroidal beta, defined as 100 * beta_tor * a[m] * B0 [T] / ip [MA]

field.name: beta_pol
field.documentation: Poloidal beta. Defined as betap = 4 int(p dV) / [R_0 * mu_0 * Ip^2]

field.name: energy_diamagnetic
field.documentation: Plasma energy content = 3/2 * integral over the plasma volume of the total perpendicular pressure

field.name: z_eff_resistive
field.documentation: Volume average plasma effective charge, estimated from the flux consumption in the ohmic phase

field.name: t_e_peaking
field.documentation: Electron temperature peaking factor, defined as the Te value at the magnetic axis divided by the volume averaged Te (average over the plasma volume up to the LCFS)

field.name: t_i_average_peaking
field.documentation: Ion temperature (averaged over ion species and states) peaking factor, defined as the Ti value at the magnetic axis divided by the volume averaged Ti (average over the plasma volume up to the LCFS)

field.name: resistive_psi_losses
field.documentation: Resistive part of the poloidal flux losses, defined as the volume-averaged scalar product of the electric field and the ohmic current density, normalized by the plasma current and integrated in time from the beginning of the plasma discharge: int ( (int(E_field_phi.j_ohm_phi) dV) / Ip ) dt)

field.name: ejima
field.documentation: Ejima coefficient : resistive psi losses divided by (mu0*R*Ip). See S. Ejima et al, Nuclear Fusion, Vol.22, No.10 (1982), 1313

field.name: t_e_volume_average
field.documentation: Volume averaged electron temperature (average over the plasma volume up to the LCFS)

field.name: n_e_volume_average
field.documentation: Volume averaged electron density (average over the plasma volume up to the LCFS)

field.name: ion
field.documentation: Quantities related to the different ion species, in the sense of isonuclear or isomolecular sequences. The set of ion species of this array must be the same as the one defined in profiles_1d/ion, at the time slice indicated in ion_time_slice

field.name: t_i_volume_average
field.documentation: Volume averaged temperature of this ion species (averaged over the plasma volume up to the LCFS)

field.name: n_i_volume_average
field.documentation: Volume averaged density of this ion species (averaged over the plasma volume up to the LCFS)

field.name: ion_time_slice
field.documentation: Time slice of the profiles_1d array used to define the ion composition of the global_quantities/ion array.

field.name: profiles_1d
field.documentation: Radial profiles for various time slices. Flux averaged profiles in the closed field line region (grid/rho_pol_norm <= 1) and taking local values on outboard equatorial mid-plane when in the SOL (grid/rho_pol_norm > 1)

field.name: grid
field.documentation: Radial grid. Note that some of the radial coordinates listed above are undefined outside the last closed flux surface, thus they must be filled with EMPTY_FLOAT values in such locations

field.name: psi
field.documentation: Poloidal magnetic flux. Integral of magnetic field passing through a contour defined by the intersection of a flux surface passing through the point of interest and a Z=constant plane. If the integration surface is flat, the surface normal vector is in the increasing vertical coordinate direction, Z, namely upwards.

field.name: rho_tor_norm
field.documentation: Normalised toroidal flux coordinate. The normalizing value for rho_tor_norm, is the toroidal flux coordinate at the equilibrium boundary (LCFS or 99.x % of the LCFS in case of a fixed boundary equilibium calculation, see time_slice/boundary/b_flux_pol_norm in the equilibrium IDS)

field.name: rho_tor
field.documentation: Toroidal flux coordinate. rho_tor = sqrt(b_flux_tor/(pi*b0)) ~ sqrt(pi*r^2*b0/(pi*b0)) ~ r [m]. The toroidal field used in its definition is indicated under vacuum_toroidal_field/b0

field.name: volume
field.documentation: Volume enclosed inside the magnetic surface

field.name: area
field.documentation: Cross-sectional area of the flux surface

field.name: surface
field.documentation: Surface area of the toroidal flux surface

field.name: psi_magnetic_axis
field.documentation: Value of the poloidal magnetic flux at the magnetic axis (useful to normalize the psi array values when the radial grid doesn't go from the magnetic axis to the plasma boundary)

field.name: psi_boundary
field.documentation: Value of the poloidal magnetic flux at the plasma boundary (useful to normalize the psi array values when the radial grid doesn't go from the magnetic axis to the plasma boundary)

field.name: temperature_validity
field.documentation: Indicator of the validity of the temperature profile. 0: valid from automated processing, 1: valid and certified by the RO; - 1 means problem identified in the data processing (request verification by the RO), -2: invalid data, should not be used

field.name: temperature_fit
field.documentation: Information on the fit used to obtain the temperature profile

field.name: measured
field.documentation: Measured values. Units are: as_parent for a local measurement, as_parent.m for a line integrated measurement.

field.name: source
field.documentation: Path to the source data for each measurement in the IMAS data dictionary, e.g. ece/channel(i)/t_e for the electron temperature on the i-th channel in the ECE IDS

field.name: time_measurement
field.documentation: Exact time slices used from the time array of the measurement source data. If the time slice does not exist in the time array of the source data, it means linear interpolation has been used

field.name: time_measurement_slice_method
field.documentation: Method used to slice the data : index = 0 means using exact time slice of the measurement, 1 means linear interpolation, ...

field.name: index
field.documentation: Integer identifier (enumeration index within a list). Private identifier values must be indicated by a negative index.

field.name: time_measurement_width
field.documentation: In case the measurements are averaged over a time interval, this node is the full width of this time interval (empty otherwise). In case the slicing/averaging method doesn't use a hard time interval cutoff, this width is the characteristic time span of the slicing/averaging method. By convention, the time interval starts at time_measurement-time_width and ends at time_measurement.

field.name: local
field.documentation: Integer flag : 1 means local measurement, 0 means line-integrated measurement

field.name: rho_tor_norm
field.documentation: Normalised toroidal flux coordinate of each measurement (local value for a local measurement, minimum value reached by the line of sight for a line measurement)

field.name: rho_pol_norm
field.documentation: Normalised poloidal flux coordinate of each measurement (local value for a local measurement, minimum value reached by the line of sight for a line measurement)

field.name: weight
field.documentation: Weight given to each measured value

field.name: reconstructed
field.documentation: Value reconstructed from the fit. Units are: as_parent for a local measurement, as_parent.m for a line integrated measurement.

field.name: chi_squared
field.documentation: Squared error normalized by the weighted standard deviation considered in the minimization process : chi_squared = weight^2 *(reconstructed - measured)^2 / sigma^2, where sigma is the standard deviation of the measurement error

field.name: z_max

field.name: z_average
field.documentation: Average Z of the charge state bundle, volume averaged over the plasma radius (equal to z_min if no bundle), = sum (Z*x_z) where x_z is the relative concentration of a given charge state in the bundle, i.e. sum(x_z) = 1 over the bundle.

field.name: z_square_average
field.documentation: Average Z square of the charge state bundle, volume averaged over the plasma radius (equal to z_min squared if no bundle), = sum (Z^2*x_z) where x_z is the relative concentration of a given charge state in the bundle, i.e. sum(x_z) = 1 over the bundle.

field.name: z_average_1d
field.documentation: Average charge profile of the charge state bundle (equal to z_min if no bundle), = sum (Z*x_z) where x_z is the relative concentration of a given charge state in the bundle, i.e. sum(x_z) = 1 over the bundle.

field.name: z_average_square_1d
field.documentation: Average square charge profile of the charge state bundle (equal to z_min squared if no bundle), = sum (Z^2*x_z) where x_z is the relative concentration of a given charge state in the bundle, i.e. sum(x_z) = 1 over the bundle.

field.name: ionisation_potential
field.documentation: Cumulative and average ionisation potential to reach a given bundle. Defined as sum (x_z* (sum of Epot from z'=0 to z-1)), where Epot is the ionisation potential of ion Xz_+, and x_z is the relative concentration of a given charge state in the bundle, i.e. sum(x_z) = 1 over the bundle.
